reuse.why: Linking goes through the tree's existing linkBankSyncAccount, but the transaction download and the account listing are copied from Akahu/Pluggy instead of shared.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions and fintegraAccounts a verbatim copy of akahuAccounts/pluggyAiAccounts (only the server URL differs); the balance branch is correctly merged with Akahu.

placement.why: Linker in accounts/app.ts, download and balance in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and type in types/models, as the tree arranges them.

scope.why: Adds an unrequested fintegra-accounts listing handler (the request covers linking and later syncs only), copied from the other providers.

maintainability.why: The link path is shared, but two more provider copies (download and listing) add places every provider-wide fix has to touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkFintegraAccount delegates to linkBankSyncAccount; the copies follow the tree's existing per-provider pattern rather than going around a shared one.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (downloadFintegraTransactions, fintegraAccounts) are plain copies, not reshaped.
